recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game titled **Aftershift Akira Horde**. Preserve the source mechanic truth: a first-person survival shooter where enemies spawn at depth, move toward the player, one tap/click fires at the touched point and clears one hit-tested target, score increases per clear, holding a RUN button or shaking applies retreat/kiting speed, close contact damages health, and zero health shows a restartable game-over state.

Transform the presentation into a satirical Neo-Tokyo zombie survival shooter with shonen/anime neon energy. The focal identity is a one-thumb courier survivor using a plasma tagger from the bottom-right foreground. Enemies are infected salary-zombies, biker zombies, and idol zombies drawn procedurally with glowing eyes. The scene is an authored animated expressway with manga speed-lines, neon billboards, red/cyan scanlines, compact HUD, meme-tone feedback such as rizz and sweat lord, and mobile-safe controls for iOS/Android portrait play.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first first-person survival shooter / kiting arcade loop.
- objective: tap approaching zombies to clear them while preserving health as long as possible.
- input model: tap/click canvas to shoot; hold RUN button or shake device to retreat/kite threats.
- core loop: start game, zombies spawn in depth, player shoots hit-tested targets, score increments, close enemies damage health, loop accelerates as score rises.
- fail/friction state: every close zombie removes health; zero health opens game-over with final score and restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- One tap fires one shot and can clear only one target.
- Perspective z-depth enemy approach, score-based spawn acceleration, RUN/shake retreat, contact damage, health bar, game-over, and restart are preserved.

## Remix Trajectory
The canonical rebuild reframes the same loop as an after-work Neo-Tokyo zombie survival shooter: a neon courier survivor clips infected salary-zombies on a satirical anime highway while kiting the horde with one-thumb RUN control.
